result_semantics.PASS: Only an accepted V1 result confirming ROCE/ROE, valid denominators from certified inputs may be PASS; no threshold is defined by this artifact.
result_semantics.CAUTION: No direct V1 CAUTION status exists; a future reviewed mapping of V1 NEUTRAL or mixed Return ratios evidence is required. Missing input is not CAUTION.
result_semantics.FAIL: Only an accepted V1 result finding adverse ROCE/ROE, valid denominators from certified inputs may be FAIL; no threshold is defined by this artifact.
result_semantics.UNKNOWN: V1 INSUFFICIENT_DATA or UNVERIFIED for missing, stale, noncomparable, conflicting or unsupported ROCE/ROE, valid denominators; never PASS.
